review_summary: Only three short Google reviews exist for Autorijschool Kwaks, all 5 stars and in Dutch. The single substantive one praises instructor Dirk for getting you on the road quickly and being easy to talk to; the other two are one-liners ('Top veilig op de weg', 'Is goed'). One reviewer shares the surname Kwaks, hinting at a possible related-party review, so the tiny sample cannot support a reliable judgment.
